title: Why Do Multilingual Reasoning Gaps Emerge in Reasoning Language Models?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating mathematical and STEM reasoning accuracy across 10 typologically diverse languages with varying resource availability (e.g., high-resource English vs. low-resource Swahili) using benchmarks like Polymath and MMLU-ProX-Lite, and conducting a stage-wise attribution analysis with targeted interventions to isolate the source of the multilingual performance gap.
